items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think it was the first time that John Lewis and all of you guys worked with Bill Evans, the piano player, in that particular setting. Bill Evans played the calliope on the waltz thing

ctx.x: Now, you made two albums because the actual soundtrack was not MJQ, but it was a larger ensemble and I think it was the first time that John Lewis and all of you guys worked with Bill Evans, the piano player, in that particular setting.
Bill Evans played the calliope on the waltz thing…
